newsitem.title: EGYPT: One killed, five wounded in south Egypt gunfight.
newsitem.headline: One killed, five wounded in south Egypt gunfight.

text.p: A 60-year-old man was shot dead and five people were wounded in a gunbattle between civilians and police looking for a wanted man in southern Egypt, witnesses said on Saturday.
A police vehicle overturned on the way to the incident, injuring two officers and nine policemen, security sources added.
The incident took place on Friday afternoon on the Nile island of Badari, about 350 km (220 miles) south of Cairo.

As police approached the home of the wanted man, they came under fire from civilians, the security sources said. The slain man, a "muezzin" who gives the call to prayer from the mosque, was at a meeting in a nearby building.
The wounded included the police captain in charge of the operation, one of his men and three civilians.
The wanted man, convicted of trading weapons, escaped.
